_metadata.description: First-class, safe, version-pinned component and hook test contracts.

requirements.title: Catalog assets declare only safe, version-pinned test behavior
requirements.description: A component or hook contract is a versioned JSON declaration with allowlisted actions/assertions and never invokes arbitrary source, paths, commands, or examples.setup.

requirements.title: A component test resolves a deterministic manifest closure
requirements.description: The runner requires an explicit root version and produces independent results for every version-pinned asset in the selected manifest closure.

requirements.title: Catalog users can run, inspect, and rerun durable test evidence
requirements.description: The Connect API, CLI, and catalog Test tab expose a version-pinned report, report history, rerun identity, remediation, and deep-linked report selection.

requirements.title: Rendered component examples prove their declared safe expectations
requirements.description: The preview browser sweep evaluates indexed role, text, and attribute expectations in the rendered iframe and captures light/dark evidence.
